evidence.quoted_text:
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
evidence.reason: `atomic` opens a `NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False)` and performs write/flush/fsync plus `os.replace` without any `try/finally` cleanup. If writing, flushing, fsync, or `os.replace` raises, the staging file remains on the durable store, so retries can accumulate orphaned files. This is an ordinary resource-cleanup defect in existing intended atomic-write behavior, not a new requirement; the fix is local and non-disruptive.
